1.text: Yesu amaze kuvukira i Betelehemu mu gihugu cy'i Yudaya ku ngoma y'Umwami Herode, haza abanyabwenge baturutse iburasirazuba bajya i Yerusalemu, barabaza bati

2.text: “Umwami w'Abayuda wavutse ari hehe? Ko twabonye inyenyeri ye turi iburasirazuba, none tukaba tuje kumuramya.”

3.text: Umwami Herode abyumvise ahagarikana umutima n'ab'i Yerusalemu bose,

4.text: ateranya abatambyi bakuru n'abanditsi bose b'ubwo bwoko, ababaza aho Kristo azavukira aho ari ho.

5.text: Bati “Ni i Betelehemu mu gihugu cy'i Yudaya. Ni ko byanditswe n'umuhanuzi ngo

6.text: ‘Nawe Betelehemu ho mu gihugu cya Yuda,Ni ukuri nturi mutoya mu midugudu ikomeye ya Yuda,Kuko muri wowe ari ho hazaturuka umutware,Uzaragira ubwoko bwanjye bw'Abisirayeli.’ ”

7.text: Nuko Herode ahamagara abanyabwenge rwihishwa, abasobanuza neza igihe baboneye ya nyenyeri,

8.text: abatuma i Betelehemu ati “Nimugende musobanuze neza iby'uwo mwana. Nimumubona muze mubimbwire, nanjye njye kumuramya.”

9.text: Bamaze kumva umwami baragenda, kandi ya nyenyeri babonye bakiri iburasirazuba ibajya imbere, irinda igera aho uwo mwana ari ihagarara aho.

11.text: Bageze mu nzu basangamo umwana hamwe na nyina Mariya, barapfukama baramuramya. Maze bahambura imitwaro yabo, bamutura amaturo y'izahabu n'icyome n'ishangi.

12.text: Baburizwa n'Imana mu nzozi gusubira kwa Herode, banyura iyindi nzira basubira iwabo.

13.text: Bamaze kugenda marayika w'Umwami Imana araza, abonekera Yosefu mu nzozi ati “Byuka ujyane umwana na nyina uhungire muri Egiputa, ugumeyo ugeze aho nzakubwirira, kuko Herode agenza umwana ngo amwice.”

14.text: Na we aherako arabyuka ajyana umwana na nyina nijoro, ajya muri Egiputa,

15.text: agumayo ageza ubwo Herode amaze gutanga, ngo ibyo Umwami Imana yavugiye mu kanwa k'umuhanuzi bisohore ngo “Nahamagaye umwana wanjye ngo ave muri Egiputa.”

16.text: Herode abonye ko yatengushywe na ba banyabwenge ararakara cyane, aratuma ngo bice abana b'abahungu bose bari i Betelehemu no mu misozi yose iri bugufi bwaho, bamaze imyaka ibiri n'abatarayimara, nk'uko yagereranyije igihe yasobanuriwe n'abo banyabwenge.

17.text: Ni bwo ibyavuzwe n'umuhanuzi Yeremiya byasohoye ngo

18.text: “Induru yumvikaniye i Rama,Yo kurira no kuboroga kwinshi,Rasheli aririra abana be,Yanga guhozwa kuko batakiriho.”

19.text: Herode amaze gupfa, marayika w'Umwami Imana araza, abonekera Yosefu mu nzozi ari mu Egiputa ati

20.text: “Byuka usubize umwana na nyina mu gihugu cya Isirayeli, kuko abashakaga kumwica bapfuye.”

21.text: Arabyuka ajyana umwana na nyina, asubira mu gihugu cya Isirayeli.

22.text: Ariko yumvise yuko Arikelayo yimye i Yudaya aha se Herode atinya kujyayo, abwirizwa n'Imana mu nzozi ajya mu gihugu cy'i Galilaya,

23.text: atura mu mudugudu witwa i Nazareti ngo ibyavuzwe n'abahanuzi bisohore ngo “Azitwa Umunazareti.”
